title: Shortcuts card on first open
request: Please look at the harvest default key bindings and perhaps have an onboarding to help new users set or learn the shortcuts. Please show me the flow and avoid extraneous text as much as possible it should be extremely clean, precise and simple
interpretation: The three timer hotkeys were bound silently on a Mac, with keys of my own choosing. They now follow Harvest (⌥⌘N new timer, ⌥⌘T show/hide; Harvest has no start/stop key, so that one is ⌥⌘P) and are offered once on a single card the first time the popover opens: three rows, each one click to change, one button to turn them on.
changes: Keys follow Harvest for Mac: ⌥⌘N new timer, ⌥⌘T show/hide; start/stop, which Harvest has no key for, is ⌥⌘P (was ⌃⌥⌘S / N / Z)
Nothing is bound silently any more: one card on first open offers the three, with one button, Turn on
Each key on the card is the recorder: click to change, ✕ to leave that row out
× or Escape binds nothing; Return is Turn on; the card never comes back
A combination another app holds is said on its row and the card stays
Rows already bound are shown as they are and left alone; no card when all three are bound, or off a Mac
